findings.issue: build requires configure.PASS only, so dual-slice header validation can be bypassed; headers PASS merely checks tool rc and probe size comparison is runtime-only though binaries are not executed
findings.required: require verified header-stage receipt before build and verified build receipt before altinstall; static asserts in actual clang probe; parse actual Mach-O architecture/minimum OS per slice and generated config hashes, retain compiler/tool raw evidence

findings.issue: Popen PID is written only in finally after wait; interruption during build has no durable birth receipt or active-stage guard. A later stage invocation can overlap an unresolved build
findings.required: persist exact process PID/PPID/UID and actual birth plus argv/log refs immediately after Popen, preserve UNKNOWN on incomplete ownership, durable stage guard prohibits another stage/replay while prior command is not terminal; transfer real handle/session for continued observation without restarting

findings.issue: R2 dependency points to superseded unsafe unpack R2 and child env repurposes HOME
findings.required: new successor freeze depends on reviewed unpack R3, retain R2 source preimage; keep inherited HOME unchanged and use task-specific absolute build/prefix/cache settings with config sites disabled

source_scope: private task-local stages only; no system install, Intel binary execution or scientific acceptance
